programme.title: FBI: Most Wanted
programme.desc: After the task force mobilizes to help apprehend an active shooter on a college campus, they find themselves in the middle of the glitzy world of college basketball; Barnes and Charlotte attempt to work on their relationship.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

programme.title: The Fabulous Four
programme.desc: Lifelong friends travel to Key West, Fla., to be bridesmaids in a college girlfriend's surprise wedding. Over the course of one outrageous trip, sisterhoods are rekindled, the past resurfaces, and there are enough sparks, sex and romance to change all of their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned.

programme.title: Black Box Diaries
programme.desc: Journalist Shiori Ito conducts an investigation into her own sexual assault, aiming to bring the prominent perpetrator to justice. Her pursuit evolves into a significant legal case, revealing the antiquated judicial and societal frameworks in Japan.

programme.title: The Space Between Us
programme.desc: Gardner Elliot, the first human born on Mars, begins an online friendship with Tulsa, a teen in Colorado. On his maiden voyage to Earth, the 16-year-old finally gets to experience all the joys and wonders of a world he could only read about. Problems arise when scientists discover that Gardner's organs can't withstand the atmosphere. United with Tulsa and on the run, the interplanetary visitor races against time to unravel the mysteries of how he came to be, and where he belongs in the universe.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: A Mighty Heart
programme.desc: Mariane Pearl (Angelina Jolie), the wife of journalist Daniel Pearl (Dan Futterman) of The Wall Street Journal, heads to Pakistan after terrorists capture her husband. In the terrifying weeks that follow, she must cope with international attention and find her way through the dangerous world of underground politics in a desperate effort to find him.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, soldier Luc Devereaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds that his superior officer, Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren), has turned violently deranged, and the two fight to the death. After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Devereaux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Love, Sex, & Hollywood
programme.desc: Emily's catering gig leads to a job at a movie star Matthew's talent agency, where she unexpectedly lands a TV role and skyrockets to fame. However, as romance blooms, disaster strikes when nude photos surface, threatening her career and his..

programme.title: The Lovers
programme.desc: An impossible love blooms across two time periods and continents.

programme.title: Hard Rain
programme.desc: The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force.

programme.title: Captive
programme.desc: Brian Nichols (David Oyelowo) becomes the subject of a citywide manhunt after breaking out of a courthouse jail and killing four people. His frantic escape brings him to the apartment of Ashley Smith (Kate Mara), a single mother and recovering methamphetamine addict. Held hostage by Nichols in her own home, the scared woman looks for guidance from "The Purpose Driven Life," Rick Warren's best-selling, inspirational book. As she reads aloud, Ashley and her would-be killer come to a crossroad.

programme.title: Florence Foster Jenkins
programme.desc: In the 1940s, New York socialite Florence Foster Jenkins (Meryl Streep) dreams of becoming a great opera singer. Unfortunately, her ambition far exceeds her talent. The voice Florence hears in her head is beautiful, but to everyone else it is quite lousy. Her husband St. Clair goes to extreme lengths to make sure his wife never finds out how awful she truly is. When Florence announces her plans for a concert at Carnegie Hall, St. Clair soon realizes that he's facing his greatest challenge yet.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

programme.title: A.C.O.D.
programme.desc: An attempt to negotiate a truce between his bitterly divorced parents sends a man (Adam Scott) back to his childhood therapist, where he learns he was the subject of her self-help book.

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A quiet man and his son take in a wounded stranger near his homestead, along with a bag full of cash. The stranger claims he's a sheriff being pursued by outlaws, but the man can't be sure.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence.

programme.title: Good Kill
programme.desc: An Air Force drone pilot (Ethan Hawke) begins to question the ethics of dropping bombs on Afghanistan from the safety of his post in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known.

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: After 20 years away, Odysseus washes up on the shores of Ithaca, haggard and unrecognizable. The king finds much has changed since he left to fight in the Trojan War. His beloved wife, Penelope, is a prisoner in her own home and hounded to choose a new husband. Their son faces death at the hands of suitors who see him as an obstacle in their pursuit of Penelope and the kingdom. Odysseus is no longer the mighty warrior his people remember, but he must face his past to save his family.

programme.title: Pelé: Birth of a Legend
programme.desc: Under guidance from manager Vicente Feola (Vincent D'Onofrio), young Pelé (Kevin de Paula) utilizes his street soccer skills to lead Brazil to the World Cup in 1958.

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

programme.title: McEnroe
programme.desc: John McEnroe finally tells his side of his storied career and performances on the court.

programme.title: Macho: The Hector Camacho Story
programme.desc: Archival footage and revealing interviews provide insight into the remarkable life and career of champion boxer Hector "Macho" Camacho, whose dynamic speed, footwork and power made him a fighter to be reckoned with.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

programme.title: Don't Knock Twice
programme.desc: A mother looking to reconnect with her estranged daughter attracts the attention of a demonic witch.

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend.

programme.title: Jeff, Who Lives at Home
programme.desc: When Jeff (Jason Segel) leaves his mother's basement to buy wood glue at the store, he looks for signs from the universe to determine his path. However, a series of unexpected and amusing events leads him to cross paths with his family, especially his brother (Ed Helms), in the strangest of circumstances and locations. If Jeff is very lucky and universally blessed, he will find the meaning of his life... and remember to buy the wood glue as well.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! The Movie
programme.desc: Arnold (Spencer Klein) and his pal, Gerald (Jamil Walker Smith), learn their beloved neighborhood is about to be torn down by a greedy developer named Scheck (Paul Sorvino) to build a mall. While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew.

programme.title: Smoke Signals
programme.desc: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes.

programme.title: Sarafina!
programme.desc: Sarafina (Leleti Khumalo) is a young black South African struggling for freedom during the apartheid. While she has remained relatively silent in her opposition of the racist government in her country, the movement to make the language of Afrikaans the official language in her school leads her to protest in the streets with her fellow students. Her anti-government views become even more intense when her favorite teacher (Whoopi Goldberg) is arrested for protesting.

programme.title: Our Ghosts
programme.desc: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Six years after his glittering triumph in the disco dance contest of "Saturday Night Fever," an older and wiser Tony Manero (John Travolta) works as a serious dance teacher in New York City and dreams of making it on Broadway. Manero gets his shot when his girlfriend, Jackie (Cynthia Rhodes), gets him an audition for a daring new show called "Satan's Alley." Manero lands a part as a backup dancer and falls back into old habits as he lusts after Broadway bad girl Laura (Finola Hughes).

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: This animated comedy finds Tommy Pickles (E.G. Daily) trying to return his baby brother to the hospital after being warned by his mean-spirited friend, Angelica (Cheryl Chase), that once his new sibling is born his parents won't care about him. But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known.

programme.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programme.desc: While shopping at an outdoor market, young reporter Tintin (Jamie Bell), accompanied by his faithful dog, Snowy, buys a model of an old ship called the Unicorn. A shady character named Sakharine (Daniel Craig) and later an American named Barnaby (Joe Starr) try to buy the model from him, but Tintin refuses. The lad discovers that the ship contains a clue about a hidden treasure, but before he can locate it, Tintin is kidnapped and given over to the custody of drunken Capt. Haddock (Andy Serkis).

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: When teenager Alan (Gregory Smith) buys a set of Commando Elite action figures, he's unaware that they have been programmed with military technology. The toys, including leader Chip (Tommy Lee Jones), spring to life and start taking their directives seriously, beginning by "killing" their enemies, the toy Gorgonites. But Archer (Frank Langella) and the Gorgonites won't go down without a fight. Alan gets caught in the middle of the war, as does his neighbor and crush, Christy (Kirsten Dunst).

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Living in exile on the planet Vulcan, the ragtag former crew of the USS Enterprise steal a starship after receiving a planetary distress call from Earth: a space probe has entered into orbit around Earth, disabled global power on the planet and evaporated the oceans. Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal?

programme.title: Spy Kids 2: The Island of Lost Dreams
programme.desc: Now full-fledged Spy Kids, Carmen (Alexa Vega) and Juni (Daryl Sabara) Cortez are back for another James Bond-style adventure. Their newest mission takes them to a distant island where they take on a mysterious man and his imaginative creatures. But this time, they also have to fight the forces of rival sibling Spy Kids, Gary (Matt O'Leary) and Gerti (Emily Osment) Giggles, as they head right into a trap that will test each and every spy in the Cortez family.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: Notorious cat burglar John Robie (Cary Grant) has long since retired to tend vineyards on the French Riviera. When a series of robberies is committed in his style, John must clear his name. Armed with a list of people who own the most expensive jewels currently in the area, John begins following the first owner, young Francie (Grace Kelly). When her jewels are stolen, Francie suspects John, destroying their tentative romance. John goes on the lam to catch the thief and clear his own name.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Sad little rich girl Alyssa (Ashley Olsen) and orphaned tomboy Amanda (Mary-Kate Olsen) meet at summer camp and discover that they are each other's exact double. And each girl is worried about her caregiver. Alyssa's father, Roger (Steve Guttenberg), is about to marry a gold digger, and Amanda's kind social worker, Diane (Kirstie Alley), will be pushed aside if a cruel family adopts Amanda. The girls decide to switch identities to make their loved ones fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Mirror Mirror
programme.desc: Snow White (Lily Collins), an orphaned princess, is the rightful ruler of her kingdom, but a jealous, evil queen (Julia Roberts) schemes to gain control. When a charming prince (Armie Hammer) spurns the queen in favor of Snow White, she has the princess thrown into the woods to be devoured by a fearsome beast. Rescued by a band of diminutive highway robbers, Snow White vows to take back her realm from the treacherous queen and, with the help of her small rescuers, roars into action.

programme.title: Cursed
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, siblings Ellie (Christina Ricci) and Jimmy (Jesse Eisenberg) come across an accident on Mulholland Drive. As they try to help the woman caught in the wreckage, a ferocious creature attacks them, devouring the woman and scratching the terrified siblings. They slowly discover that the creature was a werewolf and that they have fallen victim to a deadly curse. Now that they have been sliced by the werewolf's claws, they will be transformed into werewolves themselves.

programme.title: Outside Providence
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age comedy, Tim Dunphy (Shawn Hatosy) is leading a go-nowhere existence, spending his days smoking pot and hanging out with his best friend, Drugs Delaney (Jon Abrahams). But Tim's lazy days of getting high are jettisoned after a brush with the law convinces his blue-collar dad (Alec Baldwin) to send him to a Connecticut prep school. The one saving grace of the new school is Jane (Amy Smart), a fellow student Tim falls for immediately.

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: A serial killer (Elijah Wood) removes his victims' scalps and attaches them to the vintage mannequins he restores in his late mother's shop.

programme.title: Cusp
programme.desc: In a small military town in Texas, three spirited teenage girls live out a fever-dream summer. Through their characters, photographers and debut filmmakers Parker Hill and Isabel Bethencourt share a fascinating glimpse into authentic American girlhood, where the strictures of adolescence clash with the growing desire for personal agency.

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Experience the friendships, romances and adventures of a group of high school kids in the 1950s. Welcome to the singing and dancing world of "Grease," the most successful movie musical of all time. A wholesome exchange student (Olivia Newton-John) and a leather-clad Danny (John Travolta) have a summer romance, but will it cross clique lines?

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: The Seven Five
programme.desc: Former NYPD officer Michael Dowd tells how he and his partner committed a long list of crimes, including running their own cocaine ring, while on the job in the 1980s and early '90s.

programme.title: Marshmallow
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

programme.title: The Kite Runner
programme.desc: After many years living in the U.S., Amir, an Afghan novelist, returns to his Taliban-controlled homeland to learn the fate of his murdered friend's son.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: A big screen spin-off of the "Saturday Night Live" skit. Rob Lowe plays a producer that wants to take the public access "Wayne's World" to the world of commercial television. Wayne (Mike Myers) and Garth (Dana Carvey) battle to save their show and Wayne's girlfriend from Lowe.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: After Wayne Campbell (Mike Myers) has a dream in which Jim Morrison tells him to put on a rock concert, he and fellow late-night TV star Garth Algar (Dana Carvey) try their hand at promoting. Several musical acts show little interest, leaving the pair uncertain about their ability to put on a successful show. Meanwhile, Cassandra (Tia Carrere), Wayne's rockstar girlfriend, has a new manager (Christopher Walken) who is trying to steal her away, and Wayne's antics only make things worse.

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: Jeff, Who Lives at Home
programme.desc: When Jeff (Jason Segel) leaves his mother's basement to buy wood glue at the store, he looks for signs from the universe to determine his path. However, a series of unexpected and amusing events leads him to cross paths with his family, especially his brother (Ed Helms), in the strangest of circumstances and locations. If Jeff is very lucky and universally blessed, he will find the meaning of his life... and remember to buy the wood glue as well.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens.

programme.title: Ready for War
programme.desc: Thousands of immigrants volunteer to serve in the U.S. military -- but then find themselves deported once their tours of duty are over.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye.

programme.title: Crisis
programme.desc: A drug trafficker organizes a smuggling operation while a recovering addict seeks the truth behind her son's disappearance.

programme.title: Supercop
programme.desc: To infiltrate a drug cartel, police Inspector Chan Ka Kui (Jackie Chan) goes undercover in a Chinese prison. There, he earns the trust of Panther (Yuen Wah), a cartel member, by breaking him out of prison. With the help of another undercover agent (Michelle Yeaoh), they travel to Hong Kong and join up with Panther's gang. Ka Kui is accepted by the gang's leader (Ken Tsang), but his operation is jeopardized when Ka Kui's girlfriend (Maggie Cheung) accidentally reveals his true identity.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Villain
programme.desc: A razor-wielding London thug (Richard Burton) robs a payroll with his gang; his pimp boyfriend (Ian McShane) has the alibi.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney.. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears.

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Asking for It
programme.desc: A victim of sexual assault joins an all-female gang that targets violent frat boys and a corrupt police force of human traffickers.

programme.title: Boudica: Queen of War
programme.desc: Roman conquerors slay King Prasutagus, take away his children, and force his wife, Boudica, into subservience. Consumed by grief and a burning desire for justice, Boudica vows to reclaim her homeland from the clutches of the Romans. She soon leads her army in a desperate assault as the fate of her people and her own destiny hang in the balance.

programme.title: Personal Shopper
programme.desc: A young American in Paris works as a personal shopper for a celebrity. She seems to have the ability to communicate with spirits, like her recently deceased twin brother. Soon, she starts to receive ambiguous messages from an unknown source.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: Orphaned after the death of her parents and raised by her strict grandmother (Glynis Johns), awkward Roman Catholic high-school student Mary Katherine Gallagher (Molly Shannon) dreams about dating popular student Sky Corrigan (Will Ferrell) and becoming a star. To achieve both goals, Mary enters a talent contest, where her competitor is Sky's girlfriend, Evian Graham (Elaine Hendrix). Despite her grandmother's opposition, Mary prepares to win both the contest and Sky's affection.

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

programme.title: Love, Rosie
programme.desc: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles.

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: Vindicta
programme.desc: When a city is terrorized by a sadistic serial killer, a seasoned detective and a newly recruited paramedic are forced into a deadly game of vengeance, only to discover the key to stopping the bloodshed lies in unlocking the truth of their own pasts.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit.

programme.title: Ida Red
programme.desc: Crime boss Ida "Red" Walker turns to her son, Wyatt, to pull off one last heist to get out of prison. However, with the FBI closing in, Wyatt must soon choose between family and freedom.

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: Attica
programme.desc: During the summer of 1971, tensions between inmates and guards at the Attica Correctional Facility are at an all-time high. On the morning of Sept. 9, it all comes to a head as Attica becomes the stage for one of the largest U.S. prison riots ever.

programme.title: 16 Shots
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer is charged with murder after the shooting of Laquan McDonald.

programme.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
programme.desc: Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions.

programme.title: The One and Only Dick Gregory
programme.desc: Filmmaker Andre Gaines examines the remarkable life and career of stand-up comic, activist and pop culture icon Dick Gregory. Features interviews with Dave Chappelle, Chris Rock, Kevin Hart and others.

programme.title: Kevin Garnett: Anything Is Possible
programme.desc: Chronicling the career of one of the NBA's all-time greats, featuring scenes from Garnett's induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame.

programme.title: Green Book
programme.desc: Dr. Don Shirley is a world-class African-American pianist who's about to embark on a concert tour in the Deep South in 1962. In need of a driver and protection, Shirley recruits Tony Lip, a tough-talking bouncer from an Italian-American neighborhood in the Bronx. Despite their differences, the two men soon develop an unexpected bond while confronting racism and danger in an era of segregation.

programme.title: O
programme.desc: Moving the classic tale of Othello onto the basketball courts of a high school, the story focuses on a young black man named Odin (Mekhi Phifer) who is convinced by a conniving best friend, Hugo (Josh Hartnett) that his girlfriend (Julia Stiles) is cheating on him. Of course, what Odin doesn't know is that Hugo is in fact motivated by his own jealousy of Odin's good fortune. It's a sticky situation in classic Shakespearean tradition.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them.

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt.

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress.

programme.title: Hard Truths
programme.desc: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences.

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: In this Dickens adaptation, orphan Pip discovers through lawyer Mr. Jaggers that a mysterious benefactor wishes to ensure that he becomes a gentleman. Reunited with his childhood patron, Miss Havisham, and his first love, the beautiful but emotionally cold Estella, he discovers that the elderly spinster has gone mad from having been left at the altar as a young woman, and has made her charge into a warped, unfeeling heartbreaker.

programme.title: Kaeshammer's Kitchen
programme.desc: Blues singer-songwriter Curtis Salgado, lead vocalist for Santana and the inspiration to John Belushi's "Blue's Brothers" character, gets groovy with gumbo before grabbing the mic for a joint performance of "The Greatest Wish.".

programme.title: Classroom Classics

programme.desc: A couple hope to fix their marriage by adopting a baby; starring George Burns and Gracie Allen.

programme.desc: Based on a novel by James Hilton, this fantastical drama follows a group of plane-crash survivors who have landed in the mythical Shangri-La, a valley hidden deep within the mountains of the Himalayas. Rescued by followers of the High Llama (Sam Jaffe), the outsiders grow to love the remote paradise, but British writer and diplomat Robert Conway (Ronald Colman), suspecting that the crash was no accident, begins to investigate, leading to a surprising revelation.

programme.desc: Amid the battle between Seattle's warring factions, Ellie's search draws her toward a devastating confrontation.

programme.desc: Prison transport officer Amber must escort a mysterious criminal to court. When the convoy is ambushed, she shackles herself to him and they are forced to go on the run.

programme.desc: Ten-year-old Angelo is left behind by his distracted parents at a rest stop. He then ventures into a forest inhabited by strange, wonderful creatures to find them.

After the car breaks down in the desert, Amy accepts a ride from passing trucker Red to get help. After hours, she hasn't returned, and Jeff makes his own way to the nearby diner she was heading for. Nobody there has seen her - not even the trucker who picked her up.

programme.title: Community

programme.title: The Real Manhunter
programme.desc: Sutton revisits the 'Harvey Nichols Murder'. 22-year-old Clare was shot dead in front of customers by a man she briefly dated.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers

programme.title: How I Caught The Killer
programme.desc: Documentary lifting the lid on police investigations into some of the most incredible murder cases in criminal history.

programme.title: The Real CSI
programme.desc: Lady in the Lagoon: The body of a woman is found in a lagoon with her limbs bound together by rope. Investigators use DNA analysis and degloving to solve her murder.

A story of love and repression, fantasy and terror, sex and death, memory and longing. It is at its core a mystery story: a heart-rending investigation into the impenetrable, life-altering secrets of American adolescence.

The resourceful pair finds an abandoned hotel, and with the help of Bruce's mechanical skills, turn it into a pooch paradise for Friday and a number of strays. But when the inevitable barking makes neighbors suspicious, Andi and Bruce must find a way to hide their canine haven from prying eyes.

Le couple, formé depuis quatre mois, compte profiter de cette escapade dans un décor enchanteur pour mieux se connaître. Les confidences vont bon train. Iris raconte ses expériences intimes passées et Isaac s'ouvre sur ses souvenirs d'enfance. En forçant la serrure d'un placard, Iris trouve le matériel de soumission sexuelle du propriétaire. Le couple en profite pour réaliser un nouveau fantasme.

programme.title: Mauvais endroit
programme.desc: Frank Richards, un ancien policier, devenu agent de sécurité, assiste à un règlement de comptes entre truands qui se termine par la mort de l'un d'eux. Frank maîtrise le meurtrier et le livre aux forces de l'ordre. Pour l'empêcher de fournir un témoignage décisif, le fils du prévenu prend en otage la fille de Frank.

programme.title: Jamais plus
programme.desc: Lily décide de se lancer dans l'aventure de l'entrepreneuriat en ouvrant une boutique de fleurs atypique alors qu'elle rencontre Ryle, un homme très séduisant, qui a tout pour plaire et dont elle tombe rapidement amoureuse. C'est sans compter sur le retour dans sa vie de son premier amour de jeunesse.

programme.title: De nature violente
programme.desc: Au cours d'un séjour en forêt, un groupe de jeunes plaisanciers ranime sans le savoir la dépouille d'un homme enterré dans les bois non loin de leur chalet. Le fou furieux masqué est sorti des entrailles de la Terre pour venger son existence passée.

programme.title: Blindé
programme.desc: Un père et son fils travaillant comme agents de sécurité pour une société de camions blindés rencontrent une équipe de voleurs potentiels sur un pont. Ils se retrouvent piégés et doivent élaborer un plan pour s'échapper.

programme.title: Le deuxième acte
programme.desc: Florence veut présenter David, l'homme dont elle est follement amoureuse, à son père Guillaume. Cependant, David n'est pas attiré par Florence et souhaite s'en débarrasser en la jetant dans les bras de son ami Willy. Les quatre personnages se retrouvent dans un restaurant au milieu de nulle part.

programme.title: Insaisissable 3
programme.desc: Les Cavaliers sont de retour pour le braquage le plus impressionnant jamais imaginé. Accompagnés d'un groupe de jeunes magiciens qui espèrent suivre leur trace, ils vont devoir repousser les limites de l'illusion pour orchestrer leur tour le plus spectaculaire: dérober le joyau le plus précieux du monde des mains d'une redoutable organisation criminelle.

programme.title: Barcelone, pour toujours
programme.desc: De retour à Barcelone pour célébrer les fiançailles d'Erica avec Nico, Anna fait la rencontre d'un fermier charmant et se retrouve, par un concours de circonstances, fiancée afin de préserver l'héritage familial de celui-ci.

programme.title: Le train
programme.desc: Agathe, une enfant asthmatique, vit avec sa mère Thérèse, une artiste mélancolique. La nuit, le sifflement d'un train alimente sa vision d'un monde parallèle où transitent des voyageurs venus du futur. Adolescente, Agathe rencontre Frank, un jeune écrivain qui lui permet de franchir la frontière entre le présent et le futur.

programme.title: Ma mère, Dieu et Sylvie Vartan
programme.desc: En 1963, Esther met au monde Roland, petit dernier d'une famille nombreuse. Roland naît avec un pied-bot qui l'empêche de se tenir debout. Contre l'avis de tous, elle promet à son fils qu'il marchera comme les autres et qu'il aura une vie fabuleuse. Dès lors, Esther n'aura de cesse de tout mettre en oeuvre pour tenir cette promesse.

programme.title: Pris au piège
programme.desc: En 1998, Hank Thompson travaille dans un bar de Manhattan et habite un petit logement du quartier défavorisé Lower East Side. En rentrant chez lui avec sa copine Yvonne, Hank tombe sur son voisin Russ, le punk anglais de la porte à côté. Ce dernier lui demande de prendre soin de son chat pendant son absence. Hank hésite, mais Yvonne accepte. Au fil des jours, Hank est témoin du passage d'individus à la fois louches et redoutables qui se mettent à fréquenter son immeuble.

programme.title: Ce genre de petites choses
programme.desc: Irlande, milieu des années 1980. Bill Furlong, marié et père de cinq filles, possède une petite entreprise qui fournit le charbon à plusieurs habitants de sa petite localité. Un jour où il effectue une livraison au couvent, il est témoin d'une altercation entre une pensionnaire et une religieuse. Peu après, il croise un jeune garçon qui semble égaré, mais qui refuse son aide. Ces événements éveillent chez Bill un sentiment de suspicion qui fait remonter en lui de douloureux souvenirs d'enfance.

programme.title: Jouer avec le feu
programme.desc: Pierre, un veuf, élève seul ses deux fils depuis le décès de sa conjointe. Pendant que le cadet prépare son entrée à une prestigieuse université, le père de famille s'inquiète des relations amicales que l'aîné entretient avec des jeunes prônant une idéologie d'extrême droite. Ses efforts pour mettre un frein à ces fréquentations effritent leur lien familial.

programme.title: L'invité imprévu
programme.desc: La vie de Rose bascule lorsqu'une vieille femme se présente à sa porte en affirmant que la maison lui appartient. La soirée vire au chaos, forçant Rose à affronter ses insécurités tout en jonglant avec des relations passées et présentes.

programme.title: La dernière chevauchée
programme.desc: Un jeune homme revient dans une vieille ville du Montana pour récupérer son héritage. Pris entre un shérif respectueux de la loi et un étranger destructeur, il affronte des secrets violents.

programme.title: Désolée, bébé
programme.desc: Quelque chose est arrivé à Agnès. Tandis que le monde avance sans elle, son amitié avec Lydie demeure un refuge précieux. Entre rires et silences, leur lien indéfectible lui permet d'entrevoir ce qui vient après.

programme.title: Rumeurs
programme.desc: Sept dirigeants des démocraties les plus riches du monde tentent de rédiger une déclaration provisoire concernant une crise mondiale lors du sommet annuel du G7. Ces soi-disant dirigeants deviennent des spectacles d'incompétence, luttant contre des obstacles de plus en plus surréalistes dans les bois brumeux alors que la nuit tombe et qu'ils réalisent qu'ils sont soudainement seuls.

programme.title: Narco Hunters
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un jeune Américain meurt d'une surdose de fentanyl au Mexique, l'ex-espion Abraham Woodhill est chargé de la mission d'anéantir les cartels responsables. Avec l'aide de l'ex-agent détenu Jake Byrne, l'infâme White Devil, il déclenche une violente opération capitale à travers les villages, la jungle et les retranchements des cartels.

programme.title: La femme de ménage

Le Créateur a développé une arme mystérieuse qui a le pouvoir de mettre fin à la guerre et à l'humanité entière.

Diabetic Shelby has a health scare, which is averted but doesn't bode well for her hopes of having children. Time passes, and the women and their friends encounter tragedy and good fortune, growing stronger and closer in the process.

programme.title: Chuck
programme.desc: He was the pride of Bayonne, N.J., a man who went 15 rounds in the ring with Muhammad Ali. But before all of that, Chuck Wepner was a liquor salesman and father with a modest prizefighting career whose life changed overnight when, in 1975, he was chosen to take on Ali in a highly publicized title match. It's the beginning of a wild ride through the exhilarating highs and humbling lows of sudden fame, but what happens when your 15 minutes in the spotlight are up?

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

programme.title: Urban Cowboy
programme.desc: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children.

programme.title: The Evening Star
programme.desc: A spunky woman (Shirley MacLaine) copes with her troubled adult grandchildren, feuds with an enemy and has a fling with a younger man (Bill Paxton).

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook
programme.desc: Frankie reunites his old band for a jam session and a spin on a college-era classic - featuring Shoyu Ramen with Tare Eggs, sweet and savory Chicken Meatballs, Seaweed Cucumber Salad, and a crispy Okonomiyaki pancake.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook

programme.desc: Frankie flips the script for his wife Heather making breakfast for dinner featuring Banana Maple Pancakes, Eggs Benedict with prosciutto cotto, Home Fries with Bloody Mary Ketchup, Sausage Scrapple, and a boozy Espresso Milkshake.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: Jamie cooks up some versatile meatball kebabs, delicious crispy pork noodles, a magnificent carrot puff pastry and a humble crumble, all for under a buck per serving.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: Jamie celebrates frozen ingredients to create a scrumptious fish pie, creamy cauliflower cheese spaghetti and a warming minestrone soup, all for under a buck per plate.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: Jamie takes root veg to another level, makes scrumptious sticky BBQ chicken and turns things upside down with a pineapple cake.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie hacks his oven into a rotisserie for crispy chicken and chips and bakes a savory spinach and feta pie. Then, the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, Jose Pizarro, shares some gorgeous Mediterranean flavours using just 5 everyday ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie raids his pantry for a speedy veggie carbonara and rice pudding popsicles.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie turns frozen fish and veggies into a time saving supper. Then, Italian chef, Gennaro Contaldo rustles up some delicious homemade gnocchi using just 5 easy ingredients.

programme.title: Ces gars-là
programme.desc: Pour célébrer les 33 ans de Simon, Sam organise des retrouvailles de l'ancienne gang de l'université pour une soirée plus que mémorable.

programme.title: Minuit, le soir
programme.desc: Fanny fait la rencontre d'une jeune femme qui va bouleverser sa vie; Marc est en dépression.

programme.title: Prométhée
programme.desc: Par une nuit d'orage, Charles et Caroline Lasset, en voiture, renversent une adolescente; malgré un choc brutal, la jeune fille se relève, indemne; le couple lui vient en aide et découvre qu'elle a perdu la mémoire.

programme.title: La fièvre des festivals
programme.desc: Offrir des moments de pure magie aux festivaliers et festivalières demande un investissement total des équipes et bénévoles; aucun détail n'est négligé; les heures ne sont pas comptées; chacun se donne comme si sa vie en dépendait.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: Une spécialiste des ondes Martenot vient démontrer les multiples possibilités de cet instrument aussi étrange que fascinant; on s'amuse scientifiquement avec un jouet rebondissant; on cherche un fruit apparenté aux cerises.

programme.title: Kebec
programme.desc: Un portrait vivant du Québec en explorant son parcours socioculturel et les traces laissées par quelques-uns de ses artistes les plus marquants.

programme.title: La fièvre des festivals
programme.desc: Avec les changements climatiques, les festivals vivent plus d'épisodes météorologiques extrêmes que jamais; les organisateurs développent des solutions et réfléchissent à des façons de faire pour pouvoir continuer d'offrir des activités au public.

programme.title: La période de questions
programme.desc: La vie politique étant constamment en mouvance, il est important de bien comprendre les enjeux gouvernementaux. C'est pour cette raison que "La période de questions" est l'émission qui figure depuis le plus longtemps dans la grille horaire de Télé-Québec, soit plus de 30 ans. Télé-Québec s'est en effet toujours fait un devoir de présenter à la population la partie "questions et réponses orales" des séances de l'Assemblée nationale.

programme.title: Terminator
programme.desc: À Los Angeles en 1984, un Terminator, cyborg surgi du futur, a pour mission d'exécuter Sarah Connor, une jeune femme dont l'enfant à naître doit sauver l'humanité. Kyle Reese, un résistant humain, débarque lui aussi pour combattre le robot, et aider la jeune femme.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Barbouille est en manque d'inspiration, il ne parvient plus à créer; toute la famille tente de l'aider en lui proposant de nouveaux sujets à peindre.

programme.title: Grizzy et les Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy et les Lemmings détruisent maladroitement la télécommande du téléviseur; lorsqu'ils recherchent une autre télécommande, ils tombent sur un prototype secret de l'Armée canadienne qui permet de contrôler les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Patamuse
programme.desc: À travers une série d'histoires de trois minutes, le narrateur aide le jeune spectateur à découvrir un monde amusant, avec toutes sortes d'animaux en argile grâce à une large palette de couleurs.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon et sa petite bande de copains deviennent des super héros et se transforment en Superlapin, Super Lou, Super Ferdi et Capitaine Lapin.

programme.title: Tulipop
programme.desc: Les aventures d'un groupe d'amis colorés sur l'île magique de Tulipop.

programme.title: Lotus et Cali
programme.desc: Lotus veut aider Cali à combattre sa peur des papillons; Chopin sort sa montre à gousset et suggère d'hypnotiser Cali; cela semble bien fonctionner jusqu'à ce que la montre tombe entre les mains de Bechdel et sa bande.

programme.title: Millie la magnifique
programme.desc: Quand Millie ne peut se rendre à ses raquettes de badminton à cause d'une toile d'araignée, ses amis et elle se rendent compte qu'ils peuvent faire leurs propres raquettes.

programme.title: Milo
programme.desc: Les récits du chef Pierre donnent envie à Milo, Lofty et Lark de travailler dans son restaurant mondialement connu; après avoir servi des désastres culinaires, ils essaient de préparer un plat digne d'une reine.

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: Louis vient chercher Abacus pour aller à l'anniversaire de son père Armand, qui est toujours un événement; cependant, le scarabée est en pleine mue. Comme c'est une phase où il est vulnérable, sa mère Aperture craint pour la santé de son fils.

programme.title: Azuro & la brigade des dragons
programme.desc: Angela, la célèbre chanteuse, se prépare pour son concert à la Magic Arena; cependant, dès le début de sa performance, des éternuements inattendus provoquent le chaos alors que des flammes surgissent de manière incontrôlable.

programme.title: Super Wings et les Super Minis
programme.desc: Jett s'envole vers la capitale de l'Uruguay pour livrer à Selena une boîte dans laquelle elle veut mettre la dent qu'elle vient de perdre et la glisser sous son oreiller pour que Perez la petite souris vienne la prendre.

programme.title: Gabby et la maison magique
programme.desc: Gabby, Pandy et leur joyeuse équipe partent en safari; arriveront-ils ensemble à mettre la patte sur la créature mystérieuse?

programme.title: Les Trois Bricochons
programme.desc: Rebecca et Driss, les meilleurs amis de Bois-Mignon, se sont fâchés. Fred appelle les Bricochons à la rescousse. Mais une amitié, ce n'est pas ce qu'il y a de plus simple à réparer !

programme.title: Les Minus
programme.desc: Oli a cassé le nouveau bricolage de Titus, sa magnifique boîte à musique! Il va être super triste, à moins qu'elle ne réussisse à la réparer avant son retour.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Le jeu des papillons est très amusant au jardin, mais Bluey part avec Judo, laissant Bingo toute seule ; la pauvre Bingo est malheureuse et Bluey doit se racheter.

programme.title: Grizzy et les Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy glisse sur un trampoline et fait un saut périlleux incroyable devant l'ours; en voyant l'effet de son exploit athlétique, Grizzy décide de devenir un champion en la matière.

programme.title: La famille Weasy
programme.desc: Les filles préparent Noël malgré les moqueries de Weasy; au matin, leurs chaussettes sont remplies de cadeaux; Weasy, stupéfait, ouvre tout: deux patins disco; tenté, il les garde et les remplace par des faux bricolés.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Les barbabébés ont préparé un spectacle pour l'anniversaire de Barbamama; pendant que Barbalala termine les préparatifs, ils vont se promener à la fête foraine où Barbouille se retrouve coincé dans une attraction.

programme.title: Top Cornichon
programme.desc: Les trois amis ont décidé de préparer chacun un plat pour se faire un dîner tous ensemble. Mais oups, ils n'ont pas les mêmes goûts !

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora sauve Babouche et ses amis de la montgolfière incontrôlable de Totor pour qu'ils puissent tous aller à la fête au château.

programme.title: Les jeux de La Fontaine
programme.desc: Au patinage artistique, la discipline des Souris leur permet de remporter la coupe face aux favoris, les Crapauds Flamboyants.

programme.title: Passe-Partout
programme.desc: Passe-Partout trouve un énorme cadeau dans la ruelle; aidée de ses amis, Passe-Partout découvre que c'est pour Fardoche; Cannelle et Pruneau jouent les lutins coquins dans la pièce de théâtre de Madame Coucou.

programme.title: La Pat'Patrouille
programme.desc: Danny X le hardi était attaché au-dessus d'un canyon pour le pique-nique de l'extrême lorsqu'un vent l'a fait chavirer à l'envers; le maire Hellinger veut s'emparer d'une tarte pour faire partie du concours le jour de la fête des tartes.

programme.title: Drôle de bocal
programme.desc: Famille de poissons rouges, maître de kung-fu, bande de rappeurs, prisonniers ou étudiants inadaptés, ils essaient tous de trouver leur place dans leur bocal.

programme.title: Alix et les Merveilleux
programme.desc: Alix souhaite se joindre à l'expédition camping et feu de camp initiée par Morse et Chapelier, mais Grande-Patronne vient interrompre le projet en annonçant une grande journée d'évaluation visant à déterminer le meilleur sujet du pays.

programme.title: L'aventure du Monde des mondes
programme.desc: Raphaël rêve d'avoir une maison dans les arbres! Avec Anaïs et Blox, ils imaginent le plan de sa maison. Ils relèvent aussi la mission de leur oncle Dimitri en voyage en Guyana: trouver quatre caractéristiques surprenantes du singe-araignée.

programme.title: Comme tu es belle ! Avoir 20 ans en pays taliban
programme.desc: Sofia et Niguina sont afghanes et tiennent un salon de beauté. Malgré l'arrivée au pouvoir des talibans, elles font tout pour protéger leur dernier espace de liberté.

programme.title: Une époque formidable
programme.desc: On parle des idées conservatrices qui ont le vent dans les voiles chez les jeunes, on discute de l'importance du travail qui peut être bon pour la santé, on reçoit des invités colorés pour parler de sexualité chez les personnes âgées.

programme.title: Génial!
programme.desc: On demande pourquoi le son de l'eau qui coule donne à la plupart des gens l'envie d'uriner, une personne du public propose une expérience avec une ampoule incandescente et notre jeu du Combien est à saveur maraichère.

programme.title: Soirée quiz
programme.desc: Dernier match de la ronde préliminaire: les Quiz lorraines et le Club Sandwich, deux équipes de Montréal, font leurs débuts dans le tournoi; un duel gastronomique et très sympathique.

programme.title: Le Comte de Monte-Cristo
programme.desc: Emprisonné depuis dix ans, Edmond rencontre l'abbé Faria, qui devient son mentor et son ami en creusant avec lui un tunnel d'évasion. Mourant, Faria lui révèle l'existence d'un trésor sur l'île de Monte-Cristo.

programme.title: Poutine et les présidents
programme.desc: On relate les affrontements de Vladimir Poutine avec les présidents américains alors qu'il tente de reconstruire l'empire russe.

programme.title: Bleu océan
programme.desc: La France détient la plus vaste ZEE mondiale, située majoritairement en Polynésie ; cette zone stratégique, riche en ressources halieutiques, est surveillée par un dispositif maritime, aérien, spatial et terrestre ; embarquement avec les équipes du patrouilleur Arago et du Falcon le Gardian.

programme.title: Génial!

programme.title: Passe-Partout

programme.title: Les Millimus

programme.title: Médicos, línea de vida
programme.desc: El Instituto de Especialidades Médicas es uno de los hospitales más prestigiosos, y ocupados, que tiene el país, por la cantidad de urgencias que atiende y porque también alberga a las mentes más experimentadas de cada una de las ramas de la medicina. La historia comienza cuando durante una gran emergencia, el Doctor Lara, director del Instituto, niega la admisión de un paciente. Esta decisión es el inicio de una serie de acontecimientos fatídicos, pues el paciente fallece y uno de sus familiares decide vengarse del director Ante la necesidad de un nuevo director, el mejor candidato es el Doctor Gonzalo Olmedo, un reconocido Neurocirujano que ha dedicado su vida a brindar salud y tratamientos a la gente que lo necesita. El nombramiento de Gonzalo no es del agrado del Doctor René Castillo, el Director Administrativo del Instituto, pues él solía sacar ventaja personal a través de negocios turbios con proveedores y laboratorios, entre otros actos de corrupción. En cuanto Gonzalo toma la Dirección, se destapa una cloaca de malos manejos e irregularidades que le hacen comprender que el Instituto está peor de lo que pensaba, pero en vez de rendirse, se propone trabajar arduamente con su equipo de especialistas, para implementar un proceso de atención exitoso. ★ 6.3/10

Esta decisión es el inicio de una serie de acontecimientos fatídicos, pues el paciente fallece y uno de sus familiares decide vengarse del director Ante la necesidad de un nuevo director, el mejor candidato es el Doctor Gonzalo Olmedo, un reconocido Neurocirujano que ha dedicado su vida a brindar salud y tratamientos a la gente que lo necesita. El nombramiento de Gonzalo no es del agrado del Doctor René Castillo, el Director Administrativo del Instituto, pues él solía sacar ventaja personal a través de negocios turbios con proveedores y laboratorios, entre otros actos de corrupción. En cuanto Gonzalo toma la Dirección, se destapa una cloaca de malos manejos e irregularidades que le hacen comprender que el Instituto está peor de lo que pensaba, pero en vez de rendirse, se propone trabajar arduamente con su equipo de especialistas, para implementar un proceso de atención exitoso. ★ 6.3/10

Given how long it's been on the air, the show has an extensive archive of in-depth news stories and investigative journalism. This syndicated version offers viewers another chance to watch some of the show's previous content, serving up real-life mysteries and in-depth investigations from the show's 20-plus years on the air. Cases involving murders and missing people are frequent topics on the series that has won multiple Emmys in the news and documentary category.

programme.title: Operación Awol-72
programme.desc: Un marine desaparecido con información secreta sobre el gobierno es buscado por la policía, perseguido por un grupo de operaciones especiales ruso y por un asesino. El antiguo cantante de la banda ochentera Bros, Luke Goss, decidió con el cambio de siglo dedicarse a la interpretación. Tras pasar por títulos como ''Blade II'', le cogió justo a la acción y ese fue el género principal de su filmografía. En esta ocasión, el excantante protagoniza este thriller adrenalínico junto al rapero RZA (''La Fortaleza'') y Heather Roop (''Dead Rising: Endgame''). Además, el artista británico vuelve a encontrarse con Bokeem Woodbine (''Fargo''), con quien ya coincidió en ''Soldado de la noche''. Todos ellos trabajan bajo las órdenes de Christian Sesma (''Vigilante Diaries''). Goss y RZA no son los únicos guiños al mundo de la música. Y es que en la cinta aparece brevemente Brotha Lynch Hung, un conocido rapero de la costa Oeste de los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Emily la estafadora
programme.desc: Emily, una joven con mala suerte y cargada de deudas, se introduce en una estafa con tarjetas de crédito e identificaciones fraudulentas que la lleva al inframundo criminal de Los Ángeles.

programme.title: El último testigo
programme.desc: Inglaterra, 1947. Stephen Underwood, un joven y ambicioso periodista, detecta un número elevado de suicidios en la zona suroeste. Un insólito fenómeno que pronto levanta sospechas: todos los cadáveres encontrados corresponden a exsoldados polacos.

programme.title: El secreto de una obsesión
programme.desc: Ray y Jess, dos agentes del FBI, son relevados de su puesto, cuando aparece asesinada la hija de ella. 13 años después, Ray encuentra por fin una pista para resolver el caso. Adaptación de la oscarizada y solemne película argentina ''El secreto de sus ojos'', dirigida y escrita por Billy Ray (''Los juegos del hambre''). El director norteamericano introduce varios cambios respecto a la cinta original de Juan José Campanella (''El hijo de la novia''). El personaje principal, interpretado en la versión de Campanella por Pablo Rago (''Kachorra''), tiene el rostro de Julia Roberts (''Money Monster'') quien adquiere también más presencia en el relato. Ray intenta hacer un filme sólido y eficaz con ecos de temas de actualidad. Para ello el director cuenta con un cásting mediático, en el que además de Roberts, tiene la presencia de Nicole Kidman (''El editor de libros''), Dean Norris (''El consejero'') o Chiwetel Ejiofor (''Marte''), entre otros. A modo de anécdota, para dotar de más naturalidad y crudeza al relato del filme, la actriz Julia Roberts aparece con apenas maquillaje.

Dos jóvenes soldados británicos deben atravesar el territorio enemigo para entregar un mensaje que puede evitar un mortífero ataque contra cientos de soldados, entre ellos el hermano de uno de ellos. Veinte años después de ganar el Óscar al mejor director por ''American Beauty'', Sam Mendes se pone al mando, en este caso, de un largometraje bélico que tiene lugar en plena Primera Guerra Mundial. En ella los soldados Blake y Schofield reciben una misión aparentemente imposible, que se convierte en una carrera contrarreloj para salvar la vida del hermano del primero. El director británico cuenta con un elenco de intérpretes formado por Dean-Charles Chapman (''Juego de Tronos''), George MacKay (''Peter Pan. La gran aventura''), Colin Firth (''El discurso del rey''), Andrew Scott (''Pride'') y Benedict Cumberbatch, nominado al Óscar en 2015 por su interpretación en ''The Imitation Game (Descifrando Enigma)''. La crítica ha ensalzado esta coproducción angloamericana, hasta el punto de recibir varias nominaciones importantes para la 77ª edición de los Globos de Oro, entre ellas la de mejor película dramática y la de mejor director.

programme.title: La reina Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria fue monarca de Inglaterra a los 18. En los primeros años de su reinado, Victoria tuvo que enfrentarse a varios intentos de manipulación y a un romance con su primo. Drama y romanticismo se dan la mano en esta cuidadísima producción basada en la juventud de la reina Victoria, en la que destaca la excelente ambientación del filme. De hecho, la cinta fue candidata al Oscar al mejor maquillaje y dirección artística; y se hizo con la estatuilla al mejor diseño de vestuario. Si bien muchos hechos fueron modificados respecto a los originales, algunos escenarios escogidos son reales. Así, numerosas secuencias fueron rodadas en el castillo de Belvoir y la cama usada en uno de los fragmentos es el mueble real en el que durmió la reina en 1843. Además, los actores lucen vestidos que son auténticas réplicas de los originales y algunas piezas están valoradas en más de 10.000 euros. A parte del virtuosismo en la ambientación, destaca especialmente la interpretación de la protagonista, Emily Blunt, que ya consiguió llamar poderosamente la atención en ''El diablo viste de Prada''.

programme.title: Mensajero del futuro
programme.desc: En el año 2013, el mundo está devastado tras una catástrofe nuclear. Toda la tecnología ha desaparecido y la población lucha por sobrevivir ante los ataques de un ejército tirano, los Holnists, que recluta a sus soldados entre los más fuertes de los supervivientes. En este contexto, un fugitivo encuentra una saca de correo abandonada y se dedica a repartirlo. Este simple hecho sirve como recordatorio para la gente de su pasada forma de vida y acaba convirtiéndole en el líder de una revuelta contra los Holnists. Kevin Costner se basó en la novela futurista homonima de David Brin para dirigir y producir su segundo trabajo como director tras ''Bailando con lobos''. Al igual que los últimos trabajos en los que había intervenido el actor (''Wyatt Earp'', ''Waterworld'', ''The War''), el filme no tuvo demasiada suerte y, después de sufrir varios percances durante el rodaje, su acogida fue muy fría tanto por parte del público como de la crítica.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Doce extraños se despiertan en el claro de un bosque sin saber cómo llegaron allí. Desconocen que han sido elegidos para ser cazados en una especie de deporte en el que un grupo de ricos matan a personas por simple diversión. Thriller y terror se dan la mano en esta cinta dirigida por Craig Zobel, que está escrita por Nick Cuse y Damon Lindelof. Los tres ya habían trabajado codo con codo en la aclamada serie de televisión ''The Leftovers''. Esta violenta sátira sobre un mundo donde los humanos se cazan entre sí como si de un deporte se tratase está protagonizada por Betty Gilpin (''GLOW''), cuyo personaje -una de las presas- se rebela para darle la vuelta al juego y deshacerse uno a uno de los miembros de la élite que intentan darles caza. La oscarizada Hilary Swank y Emma Roberts (''Somos los Miller'') completan el elenco principal. El proyecto se vio envuelto en polémica ya que, en agosto de 2019, Universal Studios canceló el estreno de la cinta (previsto para setiembre) debido a los tiroteos masivos que tuvieron lugar en las localidades estadounidenses de Dayton y El Paso. La decisión se tomó un día después de que el presidente Donald Trump publicara críticas sobre la película.

programme.title: Cisne negro
programme.desc: Nina logra el papel de bailarina principal en un importante espectáculo de danza clásica. La presión de una madre controladora, la rivalidad con una compañera y las exigencias de su director le harán enloquecer. Darren Aronofsky embruja de nuevo al espectador con esta asfixiante propuesta que navega entre el drama y el suspense psicológico. Tras sacar del olvido a Mickey Rourke en ''El Luchador'', el cineasta brindó una enorme oportunidad a una intérprete. Esta vez, la elegida fue Natalie Portman, que se alzó con el Oscar a la mejor actriz y con un sinfín de premios en la misma categoría. El increíble esfuerzo de Portman -un entrenamiento de un año, nueve kilos perdidos y una costilla dislocada por el camino- le condujeron a un éxito más que justificado. Aronofsky confesó que manipuló sutilmente a Mila Kunis (''Con derecho a roce'') y a Portman para que su tensión a nivel personal se plasmara en el terreno interpretativo. Con un final apoteósico y un poderío visual hipnótico, la cinta -que optó a cuatro estatuillas más- permanecerá en la retina de los críticos y en la de millones de espectadores. De hecho, la recaudación multiplicó por 25 el ajustadísimo presupuesto invertido.

programme.title: Hijos de los hombres
programme.desc: Año 2027. La humanidad ha perdido la capacidad de procrear y el mundo se estremece ante la noticia de la muerte de la persona más joven del planeta, que tenía 18 años. En medio del caos, las autoridades contratan a Theo, un desilusionado exactivista, para proteger a la persona más buscada de la Tierra. Película de ciencia ficción distópica basada en la novela homónima de PD James y dirigida por el mexicano Alfonso Cuarón (''Y tu mamá también''). El colapso de la sociedad, el terrorismo y la destrucción del medio ambiente acompañan en el filme a una casi imparable extinción de la humanidad. El protagonismo recayó en Clive Owen (''Sin City'', ''Closer''), quien supo impregnarse bien del talento de los secundarios Michael Caine y Julianne Moore. Cuarón también acertó en la brillante fotografía de Emmanuel Lubezki, un profesional que tiene en su currículo la parte visual de filmes de la talla de ''Sleepy Hollow'', ''Cosas que diría con sólo mirarla'' o ''Quemar después de leer''. Gracias a ''Hijos de los hombres'', Lubezki consiguió su cuarta candidatura a los premios Oscar, aunque se volvió a quedar sin la preciada estatuilla.

programme.desc: Breaking the Magicians' Code: Magic's Biggest Secrets Finally Revealed, en España: Descifrando el código de los magos: Los más grandes secretos de la magia finalmente revelados (los cinco primeros capítulos, y los demás Magia sin secretos), en Hispanoamérica Grandes secretos de la magia finalmente revelados, es una serie de televisión en la que se explica cómo se realizan diversos trucos de magia e ilusionismo. Inicialmente se emitieron cuatro capítulos, entre 1997 y 1998, en la cadena FOX de Estados Unidos y en ITV y Sky en Reino Unido. El 15 de mayo del 2002 Fox retomó el formato original con Breaking the Magician's Code: Magic's Biggest Secrets Finally Revealed 5 y 6 (Rompiendo el código de los magos: Los más grandes secretos de la magia finalmente revelados 5 y 6). Estos capítulos forman parte de la primera temporada. Finalmente en 2009, una nueva serie de trece episodios fue emitida por MyNetworkTV en los Estados Unidos y por ITV en Reino Unido. ★ 7.5/10

programme.desc: Raúl, Eduardo y Santiago son amigos desde la infancia. Santiago les confiesa a sus amigos que es gay y Raúl piensa que simplemente está confuso. Cuando al fin acepta que su amigo es homosexual, Eduardo y él intentan adaptarse a la nueva situación.

programme.title: Fachon Models
programme.desc: Cuando Ulises encuentra su amor de escuela primaria como una adulto, finalmente encuentra la motivación para encontrar mejores trabajos de actuación y se pone en forma.

programme.title: Juega conmigo
programme.desc: Una joven consigue trabajo como niñera de dos problemáticos hermanos y deberá participar de un demoníaco juego para poder salvarlos. — iptv-epg.org/kofi

programme.title: Soy de rancho
programme.desc: Alfredo, un poderoso hombre que vive en un rancho, es enviado por su padre a la capital. Allí conoce a Fabiola, una mujer ahogada en deudas familiares que lo seduce para sacarle dinero.

programme.title: Hijos de su madre
programme.desc: Dos hermanos se reencuentran en un funeral y a partir de entonces vuelven a compartir sus vidas, mucho más de lo que quisieran.

programme.title: ¡Se la Sacó...Gaspar!
programme.desc: Un día Gaspar, quien está locamente enamorado de su vecina, recibe un regalo muy especial del cielo. Pero este regalo lo involucra en una serie de divertidos enredos con la policía federal y con unos secuestradores.

programme.title: Ni tuyo, ni mía
programme.desc: Roberto y Amanda son una pareja adinerada de una vida aparentemente perfecta, cuya rutina monótona cambia por completo cuando Roberto conoce a Lía, una bella bailarina de flamenco que lo enamora con su vitalidad y estilo bohemio.

programme.title: Todo lo invisible
programme.desc: La ceguera generada por un accidente de auto deja a Jonás totalmente fuera del juego. A pesar de su resistencia a aceptar esta nueva condición y a mostrarse vulnerable ante sus hijas y esposa, las circunstancias lo llevan a descubrir otros caminos.

programme.title: El tatuaje
programme.desc: Sebastián y Valentina, en prueba de amor, se tatuaron cada uno en la ingle, el nombre del otro. Pero un día antes de la boda se separan y viven las dificultades que el tatuaje les trae para encontrar una nueva pareja.

programme.title: Ni tuyo, ni mía

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.
